name: PLAYBACK GIRL
source:
You wake up in a void. You're not supposed to be here.

You don’t have a name. You don’t have a purpose. You might be a bug.

But that’s not gonna stop you!

The world is broken, the narrator is panicking, and you, a background character, have just declared yourself the protagonist. With no memory, a suspiciously glitchy environment, and floating windows full of scrambled code, there's only one thing to do:

Fix everything...?

Maybe you’ll figure out who you are! Maybe you’ll just break more things.

[From [url=https://daph0dil.itch.io/playback-girl]itch.io[/url]]
